messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "use next dose at regular time"
set: ["use next dose at regular time", "take your next dose at the regular time", "skip the missed dose and take next dose at regular time", "take next dose at usual time", "take next dose at regular time and stay on twice-daily schedule", "take next dose at normal scheduled time", "if you miss your bedtime dose, take your next dose at the regular time the following evening", "do not use two doses at one time", "skip the missed dose if it is almost time for your next dose", "skip it if it is almost time for your next dose", "give next dose as scheduled", "use lowest dose possible for shortest time needed", "wait until your next scheduled dose", "do not use two doses of semaglutide at one time", "if next dose due in less than 2 days, skip missed dose and return to regular schedule", "do not use different brands of semaglutide at the same time"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "take your next dose at the regular time",
    "take next dose at usual time",
    "take next dose at regular time",
    "take next dose at normal scheduled time",
    "give next dose as scheduled",
    "wait until your next scheduled dose"
  ],
  "alias": "take next dose at regular time"
}
